rules: Fixed on 2026-11-09 before any run had an outcome. Each frozen screen run is scored once: signal at the as-of close, buy every basket stock at the next session's open, sell at the open 21 sessions later (the backtest's one-month hold). A stock that stops trading is valued at its last traded close. Baskets are equal weight and pay the full 0.05% cost on both entry and exit (0.10%; the monthly backtest charged only the traded share, so this is stricter). Excess is the basket's net return minus (a) the equal-weight return of every scored stock in that run and (b) the benchmark ETF over the same opens. A run counts as prospective only if its manifest was written before its entry session opened (09:30 New York); runs written later are scored but reported separately and never enter the prospective record. Daily runs overlap, so the record also reports independent runs: the earliest run, then each next run whose entry is on or after the previous one's exit. No conclusion is drawn before min_independent_runs prospective independent runs have matured. Interim marks (entry open to the latest close) are shown for unfinished runs and never enter the record.

baskets.label: 漂移最强五分之一（主排名）
baskets.note: 回测验证的用法：每月持有漂移最强的五分之一，约 200 只。

baskets.label: 排名前 50（没有回测）
baskets.note: 页面默认显示的前 50 名。只买最前面几十只没有被回测检验过，波动会大得多。

baskets.label: 上升趋势中的浅回调
baskets.note: 漂移最强五分之一里近 1 个月跌 0–10% 的股票。回测超额和整个五分之一分不出差别。

baskets.label: 困境反转（看财报）观察名单
baskets.note: 回测没有通过（区间含零），只是观察名单。

baskets.label: 基本面恶化（回避名单）
baskets.note: 股价深跌且基本面继续恶化。回测里跑输，这里越低说明回避越有道理；每次只有十来只。
